note: Shelby County, Iowa zones unincorporated land under Ordinance 2006-6, but its zoning maps are published only as PDF (ordinance map amendments 2001-7, 2002-1). The City of Harlan, the largest city, publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (2014). The county Beacon viewer is behind a Cloudflare challenge and offers no public zoning layer. No ArcGIS REST zoning layer for Shelby County or its cities was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches; the only Shelby County Zoning Map on ArcGIS Online is Shelby County, Kentucky.
